description_long: The Associated Press chronology reports that President Donald Trump publicly criticized the pace and good faith of Iran nuclear talks on February 27, 2026, shortly before authorizing U.S. strikes. At 12:25 p.m., he told reporters he was unhappy with the talks but had not made a final decision; about three hours later, while aboard Air Force One, he ordered Operation Epic Fury. Oman’s foreign minister, who had helped broker negotiations, said a deal was “within reach” and later expressed dismay that serious negotiations had again been undermined. AP also describes a discussion with Republican lawmakers during the flight about whether to continue negotiations or launch a strike.
